title: Page seams 2: registries (tabs, pane kinds, menus, commands, key rows, where/focus/key owners, frame taps, loaded sections, composer extras), stream slots
what:
core/registry.js exports small registries. app.js consumes them so feature folders never edit app.js again:
- rightTabs / leftTabs: {name, icon, component, global}.
  - RIGHT_TABS, LEFT_TABS, RAIL_ICONS and INSPECTOR are built from the base plus the registry.
  - A saved tab name still validates.
  - A `global` tab renders in Right() with no focused pane (app.js:1404-1407).
  - Each rail icon accepts a badge signal.
- paneKinds: kind -> {Pane, title(p), status(p), close(p), cwd(p)}.
  - ui.xpanes = signal([{id, kind, ...}]) shares ui.tree and paneSeq.
  - Tiles renders xpanes through the registry, and the Home check (app.js:1473) counts them.
  - closePane, picker and longSide work for either list.
  - inspected = the focused chat || ui.lastChat, used by Right() and stack ordering.
  - The ~30 p.s/p.sid sites stay on ui.panes, untouched.
- splitExtras [(p, dir) -> items]; chatMenuItems [(row) -> items] merged into the sidebar chat menus.
- commands [{name, help, run}] merged into COMMANDS. A registered name OVERRIDES the base entry (app.js:525's `term`), logged once at boot.
- keyRows: the key-reference rows (app.js:500's ':term :edit :files' among them) become a keyed list a registration can replace.
- loadedSections [component] rendered in the loaded tab; composerExtras [component] rendered above a chat's composer.
- keyOwners [(el) -> bool]: the first line of the document keydown returns when an owner claims the target, before the 'even while typing' block (app.js:1638).
- focusOwners: steer()'s busy check (:366) and returnTo (:339) consult them, so a claimed focus is never stolen.
- whereOwners [(el) -> name|null]: whereNow (app.js:1525) asks them first, so T4b's 'term' needs no app.js edit.
- frameTaps [(sid, frame) -> void]: core/state.js's frame dispatch (:589's switch) calls each tap once per frame, inside try/catch, before the switch.
- extraStreams = signal(0): capped() allows MAX_SIDS - extraStreams distinct chat streams.
Also:
- panes/session.js exports Title and Glyphs and renders composerExtras.
- index.html links vendor/xterm.css (from V0).
- Stubs:
  - terms/index.js registers the rightTab 'terms' (⌨︎, global) with one line: 'terminals: the ⌨ stack lands with slice T4a'.
  - notes/index.js registers the leftTab 'notes' (✎) likewise.
  - allow/list.js is an empty loaded section.
  - allow/README.md.
tests:
tests/registry.test.mjs (pure):
- tab tables merge in order, and old saved names still validate
- the capped() arithmetic with extraStreams
- precedence of keyOwners and whereOwners
- a command override replaces the base entry, and the key row follows it
- a throwing frameTap does not stop the others or the dispatch
- xpane add/remove keeps the tile tree consistent
Reverting the registry wiring fails it.
live_check:
fake perch on PORT=48104:
- Chat panes split, close and pick as before.
- The ⌨ and ✎ rails show their lines, and ⌨ renders with no pane focused.
- A test-only xpane kind, registered from the console, tiles, focuses and closes.
- A test command override shows in `:` completion.
- A test frameTap logs frames of the fake door.
- A capped toast appears at 4 - extraStreams.
- The console is clean.
risk: Focus and key routing are global. The keyOwner early return must come before the ctrl+b/ctrl+i/alt+w block, or those keys double-fire. A command override can hide a base command; the boot log line names it.
